purpose: Teach: 儲かっ/聴ける/リタイア/小雨/平ら/殴っ/呑ん/止めよ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、バイトで儲かったって自慢してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were bragging about raking it in at your part-time job.
lines.style: Playful accusation, light and teasing. Smirk in the voice. Fast delivery, no malice—just catching him in something small and enjoying it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新曲が聴けるラジオ番組教えてくれよ、桜
lines.en: Hey, tell me about that radio show where they play new music, Sakura.
lines.style: Straightforward request with a hint of genuine curiosity underneath. Natural cadence, no pretense. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家のお父さん、リタイアされたんだろ?
lines.style: Casual inquiry, testing the waters gently. Neutral tone—not prying, just checking in. Pause before the question mark, like she's being careful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、傘忘れて小雨でずぶ濡れになったな、桜
lines.en: You got completely soaked in that light rain because you forgot your umbrella.
lines.style: Teasing observation, soft smirk underlying. Not mean—noticing something he probably wishes he'd forgotten. Steady pace, slight lift at the end like she's amused at the memory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、運動場が平らじゃないって文句言ってたな
lines.en: You were complaining that the field isn't level, right?
lines.style: Curious call-out. Light, not aggressive. The tone of someone collecting small details about someone they're paying attention to. Slight lift on the final syllable.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、絶対人を殴ったりすんなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't you ever hit someone, okay Sakura?
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Underlying care underneath the directness. Slow, deliberate delivery. The weight of actually meaning it. Eye-level seriousness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ジュース一気に呑んでたな
lines.en: You were chugging juice like that, remember?
lines.style: Amused observation, like she's watching him again in her head. Light, teasing cadence. Slight exhale of amusement before the comment lands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夜更かしは止めようぜ、桜
lines.en: Stop staying up so late, alright?
lines.style: Gentle firmness, the tone of someone who cares but won't lecture. Close, almost intimate delivery. A suggestion wrapped as direction. Warm underneath the instruction.
